title: Development Administration: Main Exam, 24 April 2018
department: Department of Social and Development Studies
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

items.text: Distinguish between development of administration and administration of development.
Distinguish between colonial and post-colonial approaches to development and its administration.
Briefly explain some of the obstacles to development administration in developing countries.
What are the key features of Max Weber's view of administration?
Explain and distinguish the role of the following in the administration of development projects and programmes. i) Legislature ii) Executive iii) Judiciary
With reference to a development project, explain and distinguish between the concept of management and the concept of administration.
Citing examples, explain the role of non-governmental organizations in the administration of development projects and programmes.

According to Irma Adelman, countries can be categorized in terms of development into Low Group, Intermediate Group and High Group. Explain the socio-economic characteristics of these categories and the role of government in promoting development in each of these categories.
Compare and contrast Classical, Modern and Post-Modern theories of public administration.
